text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in the early afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what a wonderful location♪ The 
sunshine feels so nice~~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Venting all that daily exhaustion away! 
Leaving the everyday behind, it's vacation 
time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fruits and tropical drinks sat on the 
folding table. It seemed she was fully 
enjoying her vacation.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haa... Things just aren't going well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El, you're looking not so fine. How 
about it? Care to freshen up together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm... I am sorry. Right now, El wants 
to face her own running. I have not been 
feeling well lately, you see...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why a vacation is 
necessary! You need to recharge your 
energy to face yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Relax carefree under the sun and you're 
all cleared! Now, reach your hands out 
toward that sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You come along too. C'mooon, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eh, like, like this!? Is this right!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, keep it up! You can feel the sunlight 
lifting your spirits, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
!! I can feel the warmth! Wrapped in the 
scent of the sunshine—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*... I feel completely drained. 
That's right... the sun is El's amiga...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, just relax like that. It's vacation 
time under the sun♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Kentucky... I miss those wide-open 
pasture lands so muuuuch...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taiki... Feeling a bit homesick, are 
we? In times like this, try taking a deep 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, close your eyes and take a deep 
breath... And feel the scent of the sun 
and the greenery!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath... Inhaaaale... Wait, this 
smell is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling sunshine, refreshing grass! Wow! 
It feels just like Kentucky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if the country changes, the sun stays 
the same! Now, let's return to our inner 
child and play!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!! Let's enjooy♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Imagine a vacation back home♪ Going wild 
having fun under the sun~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under Seeking the Pearl's influence, the 
two Umamusume plunged straight into 
vacation mode. It was as if this spot 
alone existed outside of reality.
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone's craving a vacation.

Everyone's looking forward to a vacation, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's because I pour my whole heart into 
everything every single day. Before I know 
it, my heart is worn down. Resting needs 
to be at full blast too, or it just won't 
balance out.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And so, a vacation to rest up with all 
your might♪ Stretch your wings and fully 
recharge your energy!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Keeping it all to ourselves is a non-non! 
Let's invite even more students~~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Say goodbye to daily fatigue with a 
vacation♪ The more you rest, the harder 
you can push tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... This feels so nice~. It's been a 
while since I could just sunbathe without 
thinking about anything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Activities are essential, too! Let's soak 
in the sunshine and build strong bodies!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With sunshine power, my punches are 
razor-sharp! Come at me, anyone and 
everyone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, a large crowd of 
Umamusume had gathered. Each of them 
seemed to be enjoying their vacation in 
their own way, relishing the break from 
the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to vacation, everyone! Forget 
about your daily routines and let's enjoy 
today to the fullest♪"

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay♪ Vacation is the beeeest!!
choice_data_list:
The sun's relaxing effect is really 
something.

The sun's relaxing effect is really 
something.
More and more students are gathering...!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay♪ Vacation is the beeeest!!
choice_data_list:
The sun's relaxing effect is really 
something.

The sun's relaxing effect is really 
something.
More and more students are gathering...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! People tend to forget, but 
the sun's energy is seriously powerful!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"What matters is changing the way you look 
at the world. Even simple turf can 
transform in a flash into the most 
exquisite bed!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's vacation together☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To break free from everyday life. 
Somewhere deep down, everyone wishes for 
that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then it's my duty to provide a vacation 
where you can truly let loose.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There must still be plenty of girls who 
need to refresh themselves!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep inviting more people! We'll 
welcome them with the absolute best 
vacation ever~~!
